A key developer differentiator on the site, but it does not appear in the top AI language; AI instead focuses on chain, liquidity, bridge, and wallet terms.
The site uses this product name for EVM compatibility and execution, but AI summaries do not surface it as a recognized term.

strengths: Clear performance differentiation: 400,000 TPS and instant finality are memorable and specific.
Strong product breadth: bridge, staking, docs, apps, wallet flow, and builder tooling are all present on the homepage.
Developer credibility is reinforced by infrastructure terms like SonicVM, SonicDB, and Fee Monetization.
Sonic has 16.7% unprompted recall in brand-free category queries, while the platforms above own the visible share of voice.

gaps: AI still surfaces Avalanche (133.3%), Polygon (122.2%), Base (80.6%), and Arbitrum (83.3%) as prominent references more often than Sonic-specific product terms.
